stdout:
Created `docs/verification/phase_g_gui_components.md` — the only file created/modified by this task (confirmed via git status; only `.abracapocus/` runtime files are otherwise touched, which are excluded per AGENTS.md).

The document records Phase G GUI components verification with all required content:

- **Phase id G and goal summary** — FFT `SpectrumVisualizer` + L/R `MeterComponent`.
- **Changed files list** — all four GUI sources: `Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h/.cpp`, `Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h/.cpp`.
- **Verification commands recorded verbatim**:
  - `cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja`
  - `cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone`
  - `cppcheck --enable=all Source/`
  - `clang-format --dry-run --Werror` on the four GUI files.
- **Real-time safety notes** — Timer capped 30–60 Hz (`MeterComponent` uses 60); FIFO/atomics consumed on the message thread only (`timerCallback`); no audio-thread repaint (`repaint()` only from `timerCallback()`); no audio-thread heap/locks; FFT/FIFO sizes must match the Phase E processor `AbstractFifo` + `std::array<float, N>` path.
- **Explicit statement that `make` was not used** as the verifier (build system note + acceptance item 6).
- **Pass/fail checklist** — recorded results for configure, build, cppcheck, and clang-format (all "Not run — toolchain unavailable", since only `/usr/bin/make` was present and is deliberately excluded).

The record honestly reflects the on-disk state: `MeterComponent` is fully authored and satisfies the RT-safety contract, while `SpectrumVisualizer` is still the skeleton stub (no timer/FIFO/FFT consume), and notes that the Phase E spectrum producer also hasn't landed per `phase_e_processor_apvts.md`, so the FFT/FIFO size-match criterion is blocked on both sides. No `Source/` files were modified.
